name: SkyPulse Arcade
subtitle: Flight, Gates & Signal Heists
promotionalText: Three offline challenges by MacWebStudio: explore twelve flight worlds, unlock crystal gates and restore eight Signal Heist systems. Train and breed your flock.
description:
SkyPulse Arcade brings mechanical birds, crystal-powered flight and signal-routing puzzles together in three free offline modes.

Developed by MacWebStudio — macwebstudio.com — the independent studio of Mcaulee Maddison.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap through pipe openings, collect crystals and chase your best score. Travel through twelve worlds, from Neon City to Polar Glow, with a new environment every 15 gates. Build a flock with useful reward traits while keeping the same responsive flight handling for every bird.

PULSE RELAY
Fly four fresh daily circuits through an orbital station. Collect the two randomly placed crystals for each numbered gate: the first charges its ring, and the second unlocks it automatically. Red lasers turn blue when passage is safe. Clear the hoops, avoid the runway and reach the exit, then move straight to your next mission. Circuits refresh each UTC day; today's routes and medals survive restarts.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Restore eight systems through eight increasingly demanding Signal Heist vaults. Tap prisms to rotate mirrors and route live energy to every core and the uplink. Splitters divide the beam; powered relays open matching shutters. Plan within your trace budget. Use PLAN to preview the next beam path and its exact cost before committing. Completing a vault saves its medal and opens the next puzzle immediately.

YOUR FLOCK, YOUR PROGRESSION
Unlock 15 founder birds, train their reward traits and breed owned parents to add offspring to your Hangar. Preview inherited traits and crystal costs before confirming; both parents stay in your collection. Each completed training level adds 2% off future founder-bird unlocks, up to 20%.

Evolve the SkyPulse Core through Ion, Jade, Prism, Solar and Nova. Core levels raise training and lineage limits, and levels 2–5 reduce Tech Tree, training and breeding costs by 5%, 10%, 15% and 20%. Explore nine connected Tech Tree families with three levels each. Every purchase shows its effect and final price first. Bird traits and Tech bonuses apply to Endless Route; Relay keeps equal flight rules.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Switch modes from the badge on Home. Each mode has its own setting, progress and relevant controls. Four daily tasks offer up to 20 crystals per UTC day. How to Play covers flight, power-ups, worlds, Core evolution, training, breeding and the puzzle rules.

Designed for portrait play on iPhone and iPad, with pause, retry, Main Menu, Reduced Motion, sound and haptic settings. Play offline with no advertising, player account or real-money purchases. Progress and preferences are saved on your device.

Explore SkyPulse and get support at skypulse.macwebstudio.com.
Developer website: macwebstudio.com.

SkyPulse Arcade — saved listing update, 9 November 2026

PUBLIC REVIEW HOLD
Do not submit this version for review. The developer is awaiting Apple's clarification of the similarity finding and the reference to a terminated developer account. Saving this draft is not a request for review.

DEVELOPER IDENTITY
SkyPulse Arcade is developed by Mcaulee Maddison under his MacWebStudio brand, macwebstudio.com. The public description credits MacWebStudio; the Apple developer account and copyright owner remain Mcaulee Maddison. This branding update does not change the bundle identifier, account ownership or signing identity.

BUILD AND MEDIA STATUS
At this update, the saved version selects historical build 1.0.0 (15). Build 19 is the last locally recorded iPhone candidate; it was installed directly, not uploaded. Current bird sculptures and world refinements are local Unity visual-review candidates, not accepted shipping artwork. No iPhone export, signing, installation or further device testing is authorized until the developer approves the visual previews.

The retained build 7 attachment and older product-page media are historical. They do not demonstrate the current local candidate. A matching uploaded build and fresh, accurate screenshots/video must be selected before a future separately authorized review submission. No new 3D roster is claimed to be included in the selected build 15.

GAME WALKTHROUGH
1. Home opens on Endless Route. Tap the mode badge to switch between three free offline modes. Each has its own Home and progress.
2. Endless Route: tap the playable area to flap, clear pipes and collect crystals. Twelve worlds change every 15 gates. Bird training, Core evolution, breeding and the nine-family Tech Tree support collection and reward progression; bird handling stays equal.
3. Pulse Relay: four circuits refresh each UTC day. Two numbered crystals unlock their matching gate automatically before collision resolution. Red lasers turn blue; there is no FLAP or PULSE button. A clear offers Next Mission when another circuit remains.
4. Blackout Protocol / Signal Heist: rotate prisms to route energy to all cores and the uplink. Splitters divide beams, powered relays open shutters, and turns spend trace. PLAN previews the next beam and cost. Clears save once and activate the next vault immediately. Eight systems provide the campaign objective. Blackout has no Bird Hangar or Tech Tree.
5. Daily tasks, pause/retry, Main Menu, Reduced Motion, sound and haptics are available. Progress and preferences stay on device. No player login, advertising or real-money purchases.

PROVENANCE AND SIMILARITY
The developer states this is his own project with AI coding assistance, with artwork generated using ARTA/ChatGPT and references from his own images or generated outputs. Source history and an artwork evidence ledger are retained. These statements do not assert exclusive legal rights to AI-generated material.

The developer states he has never had another Apple developer account and has not supplied this game through another account, publisher, contractor or purchased game template. Apple's private comparison remains unidentified. This saved listing does not claim that the similarity finding has been resolved.
